items.title: 10.18 Ion concentration ke saath E ki tabdeeli (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.18 with Table 10.1, printed page 234.

blocks.text: Equilibrium ki position concentration, darja hararat aur dabao ki tabdeeliyon se mutasir hoti hai, to half-cell ki concentration ya darja hararat badalna us ka electrode potential badalta hai; ghair-standard halaat mein symbol E istemal hota hai. Metal/metal ion equilibrium Zn2+(aq) + 2e- se Zn(s), E standard = -0.76 V, ke liye: agar [Zn2+] 1.00 mol dm-3 se zyada ho to E ki qeemat kam manfi (zyada musbat) ho jati hai, maslan -0.61 V; agar [Zn2+] 1.00 mol dm-3 se kam ho to E zyada manfi (kam musbat), maslan -0.80 V. Le Chatelier ka usool redox equilibria par lagoo hai: baen taraf ki species ki concentration barhana equilibrium daen shift karta hai, to E zyada musbat (kam manfi) hota hai.

Agar half-cell mein do mukhtalif ions hon to dono par ghaur karna hota hai, jaise Fe3+ + e- se Fe2+, E standard = +0.77 V dono ions 1.00 mol dm-3 par. Table 10.1 asar dikhati hai: [Fe3+] 1.00 se oopar le jana ya [Fe2+] 1.00 se neeche E zyada musbat (+0.85 V) karta hai; [Fe3+] ghatana ya [Fe2+] barhana use kam musbat (+0.70 V) karta hai.

blocks.caption: Ion concentration ke saath potential ki tabdeeli (Table 10.1; teer 1.00 mol dm-3 se oopar ya neeche parhe gaye)

blocks.prompt: Half-reaction ke electrode potential par ion concentration ki tabdeeli ka kya asar hai (Quick Check 10.9b)?
blocks.explanation: Baen taraf ki oxidised species ki concentration barhana reduction equilibrium ko daen dhakelta aur E zyada musbat karta hai; daen taraf ki reduced species barhana, ya baen ion ghatana, use baen dhakelta aur E zyada manfi karta hai. Sirf standard 1.00 mol dm-3 halaat mein E E standard ke barabar hota hai.

items: Ghair-standard E: zyada Zn2+ E ko kam manfi karta hai (-0.61 V), kam Zn2+ zyada manfi (-0.80 V); Le Chatelier: baen species zyada ho to daen shift, E zyada musbat; Fe3+/Fe2+ (+0.77 V) tanasub badalne par +0.85 ya +0.70 V hota hai.
